shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if test -f ../round-brief.md; then echo '--- round-brief.md ---'; sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; else echo '--- no round-brief.md ---'; fi"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "echo '--- .lore/dod.md ---'; sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md; echo '--- round brief remainder ---'; sed -n '1,500p' ../round-brief.md; echo '--- status ---'; git status --short --branch; echo '--- recent log ---'; git log --oneline -5"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "wc -l -c ../round-brief.md; sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md; echo '--- test links area ---'; sed -n '300,700p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; echo '--- package/test commands ---'; sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml; echo '--- files ---'; rg --files | rg 'onErrorNonError|chatOrchestrator|spec-links|package.json|vitest' "

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "echo '--- architecture links ---'; rg -n '\\[validated by:|\\[validated by ' specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md; echo '--- test titles ---'; rg -n \"it\\('|test\\(\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; echo '--- hooks spec links ---'; rg -n 'validated by' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; echo '--- source catch ---'; rg -n -C 8 'onError|instanceof Error|catch' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; echo '--- package scripts ---'; node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts; git show --stat --oneline HEAD; git show --format= -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md | sed -n '1,260p'; git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '100,145p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; sed -n '450,560p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; rg -n '\\(\\[validated by|validated by:' src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -30; sed -n '1,140p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs; rg -n 'specs/.*#|spec:' src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -30"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n '\\[validated by' src scripts | head -40; rg -n 'specs/.*#' src scripts | head -40; sed -n '1,120p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t 'wraps an undefined rejection with the original value as its cause' --runInBand"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md && node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs --fix; git status --short; git diff --check; git diff --stat; git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md | sed -n '1,320p'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,30p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; git diff -- specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; git diff --check; git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && git commit -m "fix: cover undefined onError rejection" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD && git rev-parse @{upstream}'
